english.description: Win a game without making any attacks. Mind Benders can be used to convert your enemies in a non violent way and it is ok to capture cities as long as you don't hurt anyone.
english.name: Pacifist

english.description: ...or die trying. Have 1000 stars at your displosal at any time in a Perfection game. Try to build your economy while also saving up stars each turn (this is tricky).
english.name: Richie

english.description: Become the greatest Architect of all time by completing all 7 monuments in a single Perfection game.
english.name: Completionist

english.description: Focus all your effort to make one of your cities reach level 12 before the time runs out in a Perfection game.
english.name: MegaCity

english.description: Unsiege a city by making the enemy just disappear into thin air. This is for the Pro players, if you don't know how it is done, consult the mighty Oracle (the internet).
english.name: Houdini

english.description: Create a max level Windmill. Burning forests can be a way to create the crop you need to succeed.
english.name: FarmMaster

english.description: Create a max level Saw Mill. The Spiritualism tech gives you the ability to plant new forests if the map spawn is not in your favour.
english.name: WoodMaster

english.description: Please all of the Polytopian Gods by building four unique types of temples: Forest Temple, Mountain Temple, Water Temple and a Field Temple (Ice Temple also works if you are Polaris).
english.name: LoveOfGod

english.description: Kill 5 units in the same turn with one unit. A Knight is probably the best unit to do this with since it can chain many units in a row.
english.name: ChainSaw

english.description: Raise 7 Fire Dragons and keep them alive. The ∑∫ỹriȱŋ tribe is the only one who has the ability to raise Dragons, so that is a requirement to succeed.
english.name: FireDragon

english.description: Freeze every single tile of the world. The Polaris tribe is a requirement since that is the only tribe that has the power to freeze, using their Moonies and Gaamis.
english.name: Frozen

english.description: Perfect the unique Poison ability of the Cymanti tribe until you have 20 enemy units infected at the same time.
english.name: Epidemic

english.description: Win a Domination game as the Aquarion tribe without ever touching any land tiles. Remember that the puffer fish can drain land tiles from a distance to allow your water units to move inland.
english.name: StayWet

english.description: Have a peace treaty with 100% of your opponents at the same time in a Domination game. Requires the Diplomacy tech and some creative play to make everyone love you.
english.name: Diplomat

english.description: Win a domination game training only 1 type of unit in your cities. Your starting unit does not count, Giants and ship upgrades are also allowed.
english.name: Monoculture
